About EvenSpec

EvenSpec puts AI model API prices and specs on one fair sheet: same units (USD per 1M tokens), same fields, updated daily from public data. Tracking started on 2026-11-21; the current dataset was generated on 2026-11-23 and covers 4,556 priced models.

Data sources & licenses

  • Primary: the LiteLLM model prices & context window dataset, licensed under the MIT License (© BerriAI). Prices shown as "Listed price (LiteLLM)" come from this dataset, which itself cites each provider's official source.
  • Secondary: OpenRouter's public model list. Where a matching model exists, its OpenRouter price is shown alongside, clearly labeled and linked, as a reference only.

Accuracy

Prices change frequently and this site is compiled automatically. Always verify prices against the provider's official pricing page before purchasing. If you spot an error, the underlying LiteLLM dataset is open source and accepts corrections.

Affiliate disclosure

Some outbound links on this site may be affiliate links: if you sign up with a provider through one, EvenSpec may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Affiliate relationships never change the prices or the order of the data shown — every model is listed from the same public dataset, whether or not a program exists. Core model providers (including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google) do not offer public affiliate programs, and no provider pays for placement in the tables.

Contact

EvenSpec is an independent project, not affiliated with any model provider.
